channel.title: The Line Of Best Fit - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Line Of Best Fit (thelineofbestfit.com)

item.title: Revisiting the radical blueprint of Sakamoto’s lost debut
item.description: Fifty years on, the first meeting of Ryuichi Sakamoto and Toshiyuki Tsuchitori is reissued on vinyl, revealing a breathtaking collision of gamelan, free jazz, and electronic ambition that pre-empted a legend.

item.title: Hockitay's “over/over” demonstrates retreat as an act of resistance
item.description: The latest single from Guatemalan-born, Montreal-based artist Hockitay marks the first glimpse of a new EP arriving in 2026, shaped by a growing disillusionment with the state of the world.

item.title: Thundercat shares new single "She Knows Too Much", featuring Mac Miller
item.description: Thundercat has released "She Knows Too Much" featuring late rapper Mac Miller, the newest single from his upcoming fifth album, Distracted.

item.title: Beak> bassist Billy Fuller announces debut solo album, Fragments
item.description: Bassist Billy Fuller has revealed the details of his upcoming debut solo album Fragments, and shared opening track, "Rummer".

item.title: Watch Throwing Muses' Kristin Hersh play for Best Fit's secret sessions at End of the Road
item.description: As part of her pop-up show for Best Fit at End of the Road Festival back in September last year, the legendary Kristin Hersh rolled out her take on "The Cuckoo", a classic English folk song from her childhood.

item.title: Yaya Bey details seventh album, Fidelity
item.description: New York singer-songwriter Yaya Bey has announced her upcoming seventh album, Fidelity, and shared new single "Blue".

item.title: Snail Mail shares new single, "My Maker"
item.description: Snail Mail, the project of singer-songwriter Lindsey Jordan, has released "My Maker", the second single from her upcoming third album, Ricochet.

item.title: Bladee features on new Këkht Aräkh track, "Eternal martyr"
item.description: Ukranian artist Këkht Aräkh has released new single "Eternal martyr", featuring Bladee.

item.title: 100%WET, RAKEL, Iris Caltwait, and more confirmed for for SPOT Festival 2026
item.description: SPOT Festival has announced the first 45 artists on the line-up for its 2026 edition, which will take place in Aarhus, Denmark, between 1-2 May.

item.title: "A joyous space for the misfits":Julia Cumming announces debut solo album Julia
item.description: Sunflower Bean's Julia Cumming has revealed her self-titled debut Julia will arrive on this April and is "the ultimate anti-cool album", inspired by the likes of Burt Bacharach, Carole King, Joni Mitchell and Brian Wilson.
